For a>0 the condition b+2sqrt(a)>=0 is exactly quadratic nonnegativity for all y>0, equality permitting only a measure-zero horizontal zero set. The smooth Bendixson–Dulac contradiction follows for any Jordan orbit. For the step, div(BF_-)= -P/(r*y), div(BF_+)=div(BF_-)-q*epsilon/r, and B(F_+-F_-)·n=-q(1+epsilon T)/r<0. Escape sliding is impossible because F_+,y=F_-,y-q*T, all sliding attracts. Splitting a hypothetical Jordan interior across the switch, the interface contributes B(F_--F_+)·n>0 and sliding boundary arcs have nonnegative weighted outward flux, while the bulk integrals are strictly negative; the Green divergence balance contradicts existence. This includes the equality threshold and finite tangent endpoints, not pathological inclusion solutions. The independent symbolic derivation checks every bulk and jump identity.

final_claim: For all positive c,beta,r,alpha,epsilon,s,q satisfying b+2sqrt(a)>=0, with a=epsilon(beta+2r), b=beta+epsilon+r(1-epsilon), the Peng–Xiang positive-quadrant tumor–immune flow has no nonconstant periodic orbit under any C1 nondecreasing h:(0,infinity)->[0,1], and no positive simple piecewise-regular Filippov threshold cycle, even with attracting sliding arcs, at any positive threshold.
limitations: Strict positive quadrant, positive rates, all C1 nondecreasing h or finite-piece simple Filippov Jordan cycles; no arbitrary discontinuous inclusion pathology, equilibrium global stability, or converse existence outside the bound.
